stimulus.text: Original secondary passage written for this question. Before 1492, the Americas held many different societies. In the Mississippi valley, Cahokia stood as a large city of farmers and traders. In Mexico and Peru, the Aztec and Inca empires ruled millions of people. Smaller farming villages and hunting peoples lived across North America. At the same time, Europeans sought a sea route to the spices and silks of Asia, and Portuguese sailors had already sailed down the west coast of Africa, learning to use the winds and currents of the Atlantic.

parts.prompt: Identify one characteristic of Indigenous societies in the Americas before 1492.
Explain how one European development before 1492 helped make transatlantic contact possible.
Explain one way the arrival of Europeans changed Indigenous societies in Period 1.
